>
> \(iii\) The **Named Insured** must report the newly acquired or constructed property to us within 30 days and pay any additional premium due.

**(g) Personal Effects and Property of Others**

We will pay for loss of or damage to personal effects owned by the **Named Insured**, officers, partners, members, managers, or employees of the **Named Insured**, and property of others in the **Named Insured\'s** care, custody, or control, caused by or resulting from a **Covered Cause of Loss**. The most we will pay under this Additional Coverage is **\$10,000 per occurrence**. This amount is included within, and not in addition to, the Limit of Insurance for Coverage B.

**(h) Valuable Papers and Records --- Cost of Research**

We will pay for the cost to research, replace, or restore the lost information on valuable papers and records, including those that exist on electronic or magnetic media, for which duplicates do not exist, when such loss is caused by or resulting from a **Covered Cause of Loss**. The most we will pay under this Additional Coverage is **\$25,000 per occurrence**. This amount is in addition to the applicable Limit of Insurance.

**(i) Electronic Data**

We will pay for the cost to replace or restore electronic data that has been destroyed or corrupted by a **Covered Cause of Loss**. Electronic data means information, facts, or computer programs stored as or on, created or used on, or transmitted to or from computer software (including systems and applications software), on hard disks or floppy disks, CD-ROMs, tapes, drives, cells, data processing devices, or any other repositories of computer software that are used with electronically controlled equipment. The most we will pay under this Additional Coverage is **\$50,000 per occurrence**. This amount is in addition to the applicable Limit of Insurance. This Additional Coverage does not apply to electronic data that is integrated in and operates or controls the **building\'s** elevator, lighting, heating, ventilation, air conditioning, or security system.

**[SECTION IV --- EXCLUSIONS]{.underline}**

**[4.0 Exclusions Preamble --- Anti-Concurrent Causation Clause]{.underline}**

We will not pay for loss or damage caused directly or indirectly by any of the following. Such loss or damage is excluded regardless of any other cause or event that contributes concurrently or in any sequence to the loss. These exclusions apply whether or not the loss event results in widespread damage or affects a substantial area.

**[4.1 Exclusion 1 --- Ordinance or Law]{.underline}**

We will not pay for loss or damage caused by or resulting from the enforcement of or compliance with any ordinance or law regulating the construction, use, repair, or demolition of a **building** or other structure, including any ordinance or law that requires the tearing down of any property, including the cost of removing its debris. This exclusion applies whether the ordinance or law is in force at the time of loss or is adopted after the loss. This exclusion does not apply to the amount of coverage provided under the Additional Coverage for Increased Cost of Construction --- Ordinance or Law in Section III, Paragraph 3.4(e).

**[4.2 Exclusion 2 --- Earth Movement]{.underline}**

We will not pay for loss or damage caused by or resulting from earthquake, including tremors and aftershocks and any earth sinking, rising, or shifting related to such event; volcanic eruption, including any airborne volcanic blast or airborne shock waves; volcanic ash, dust, or particulate matter; lava flow; landslide, including any earth sinking, rising, or shifting related to such event; mudslide or mudflow; mine subsidence, meaning subsidence of a man-made mine, whether or not mining activity has ceased; earth sinking (other than sinkhole collapse), rising, or shifting, including soil conditions that cause settling, cracking, or other disarrangement of foundations or other parts of realty.

This exclusion applies regardless of whether the earth movement is caused naturally or is contributed to or aggravated by any act or omission of the **Named Insured** or any other person. However, if fire or explosion ensues, we will pay for the loss or damage caused by the ensuing fire or explosion.

**[4.3 Exclusion 3 --- Governmental Action]{.underline}**

We will not pay for loss or damage caused by or resulting from seizure or destruction of property by order of governmental authority. This exclusion does not apply to actions taken at the time of a fire to prevent its spread, if the fire would be covered under this Coverage Part as a **Covered Cause of Loss**.

**[4.4 Exclusion 4 --- Nuclear Hazard]{.underline}**

We will not pay for loss or damage caused by or resulting from nuclear reaction, nuclear radiation, or radioactive contamination, whether controlled or uncontrolled, and whether such loss be direct or indirect, proximate or remote, or be in whole or in part caused by, contributed to, or aggravated by any **Covered Cause of Loss**. However, if fire ensues, we will pay for the direct loss or damage caused by the ensuing fire, provided that such ensuing fire is not otherwise excluded under this Coverage Part. Nuclear reaction, nuclear radiation, or radioactive contamination, whether controlled or uncontrolled, is not considered fire, explosion, or smoke for the purposes of this Coverage Part.

**[4.5 Exclusion 5 --- Utility Services]{.underline}**

We will not pay for loss or damage caused by or resulting from the failure of power, communication, water, or other utility service supplied to the described **premises**, however caused, if the failure occurs away from the described **premises**. Failure of any utility service includes lack of sufficient capacity and reduction in supply, but does not include the intentional interruption of utility service at the described **premises** at the direction of the **Named Insured**. However, if the failure of utility service results in a **Covered Cause of Loss**, we will pay for the loss or damage caused by that **Covered Cause of Loss**.

**[4.6 Exclusion 6 --- War and Military Action]{.underline}**

We will not pay for loss or damage caused by or resulting from war, including undeclared or civil war; warlike action by a military force, including action in hindering or defending against an actual or expected attack, by any government, sovereign, or other authority using military personnel or other agents; insurrection, rebellion, revolution, usurped power, or action taken by governmental authority in hindering or defending against any of these.

**[4.7 Exclusion 7 --- Water]{.underline}**

We will not pay for loss or damage caused by or resulting from any of the following:

> \(a\) Flood, surface water, waves (including tidal wave and tsunami), tides, tidal water, overflow of any body of water, or spray from any of these, all whether or not driven by wind (including storm surge);
>
> \(b\) Mudslide or mudflow;
>
> \(c\) Water that backs up or overflows or is otherwise discharged from a sewer, drain, sump, or related equipment;
>
> \(d\) Water under the ground surface pressing on, or flowing or seeping through foundations, walls, floors, or paved surfaces; basements, whether paved or not; or doors, windows, or other openings.

This exclusion applies regardless of whether any of the above, in subparagraphs (a) through (d), is caused by an act of nature or is otherwise caused, and regardless of any other cause or event that contributes concurrently or in any sequence to the loss. However, if fire, explosion, or sprinkler leakage results from any of the situations described in subparagraphs (a) through (d) above, we will pay for the loss or damage caused by that resulting fire, explosion, or sprinkler leakage.

**[4.8 Exclusion 8 --- Neglect]{.underline}**

We will not pay for loss or damage resulting from the **Named Insured\'s** neglect to use all reasonable means to save and preserve property at and after the time of loss, or when property is endangered by a **Covered Cause of Loss**.

**[4.9 Exclusion 9 --- Mold, Fungus, and Bacteria]{.underline}**

We will not pay for loss or damage caused directly or indirectly by the presence, growth, proliferation, spread, or any activity of **fungi**, wet rot, dry rot, **bacteria**, or **mold**. This exclusion applies whether or not the loss event results in widespread damage or affects a substantial area. This exclusion applies regardless of any other cause or event that contributes concurrently or in any sequence to the loss, including but not limited to any **Covered Cause of Loss**.

This exclusion is absolute and applies without exception. No coverage is provided under this policy for any loss or damage arising from or related to **fungi**, wet rot, dry rot, **bacteria**, or **mold**, whether or not such **fungi**, wet rot, dry rot, **bacteria**, or **mold** results from, is caused by, or is a consequence of a **Covered Cause of Loss** or any other event or condition.

**[4.10 Exclusion 10 --- Wear, Tear, Deterioration]{.underline}**

We will not pay for loss or damage caused by or resulting from any of the following: wear and tear; rust, corrosion, or oxidation; decay; marring or scratching; settling, cracking, shrinking, bulging, or expansion of pavements, patios, foundations, walls, floors, roofs, or ceilings; deterioration; hidden or latent defect; inherent vice; loss of weight; use of faulty materials; or any quality in the property that causes it to damage or destroy itself.

However, if a **Covered Cause of Loss** results from any of the causes of loss listed in this exclusion, we will pay for the loss or damage caused by that resulting **Covered Cause of Loss**.

**[4.11 Exclusion 11 --- Mechanical Breakdown]{.underline}**

We will not pay for loss or damage caused by or resulting from mechanical breakdown, including rupture or bursting caused by centrifugal force. However, if a **Covered Cause of Loss** results from mechanical breakdown, we will pay for the loss or damage caused by that resulting **Covered Cause of Loss**.

**[4.12 Exclusion 12 --- Intentional Loss]{.underline}**

We will not pay for loss or damage arising out of any act an **insured** commits or conspires to commit with the intent to cause a loss. In the event of such an act, no **insured** is entitled to coverage under this Coverage Part, even **insureds** who did not commit or conspire to commit the act. This exclusion does not apply to acts of destruction ordered by governmental authority taken at the time of a fire to prevent its spread, if the fire would be covered under this Coverage Part.

**[4.13 Exclusion 13 --- Voluntary Parting]{.underline}**

We will not pay for loss or damage resulting from voluntary parting with any property by the **Named Insured** or anyone else to whom the **Named Insured** has entrusted the property, if the parting is induced by any fraudulent scheme, trick, device, or false pretense.

**[4.14 Exclusion 14 --- Terrorism]{.underline}**

We will not pay for loss or damage caused directly or indirectly by any act of terrorism as defined in the Terrorism Risk Insurance Program Reauthorization Act (**TRIPRA**), as amended, or any successor legislation thereto. An act of terrorism means any act that is certified by the Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation with the Secretary of Homeland Security and the Attorney General of the United States, to be an act of terrorism pursuant to **TRIPRA**.

This exclusion applies to any loss or damage arising from an act of terrorism, regardless of any other cause or event that contributes concurrently or in any sequence to the loss, including but not limited to fire, smoke, explosion, or any other **Covered Cause of Loss**.

Notwithstanding this exclusion, coverage for certified acts of terrorism is available upon request and payment of additional premium. If the **Named Insured** elects terrorism coverage, an endorsement will be issued modifying this exclusion in accordance with the terms and conditions of such endorsement.

If the **Named Insured** does not elect terrorism coverage, this exclusion shall apply in full and no coverage will be provided for any loss or damage caused by or resulting from a certified act of terrorism. The **Named Insured** should consult with their agent or broker regarding the availability and terms of terrorism coverage under this policy.

Coverage for acts that are not certified as acts of terrorism under **TRIPRA** may be available under the other provisions of this policy, subject to all applicable terms, conditions, limitations, and exclusions.

**[4.15 Exclusion 15 --- Cyber Incident]{.underline}**

We will not pay for loss or damage caused by or resulting from any unauthorized access to or use of any computer system, including but not limited to any computer, computer network, computer system, microprocessor, microcontroller, or any similar electronic device or system, whether the property of the **Named Insured** or not. This exclusion applies to loss or damage caused by or resulting from malware, ransomware, hacking, phishing, denial of service attacks, unauthorized transmission of code, or the unauthorized appropriation of data. However, if fire or explosion ensues from any cyber incident described above, we will pay for the loss or damage caused by such ensuing fire or explosion.

**[4.16 Exclusion 16 --- Asbestos]{.underline}**

We will not pay for loss, damage, cost, or expense arising from or related to asbestos or asbestos-containing materials, including but not limited to the cost or expense to test for, monitor, remove, encapsulate, contain, treat, neutralize, or dispose of asbestos or asbestos-containing materials, or any material or substance containing asbestos, whether or not airborne.

**[SECTION V --- COVERAGE CONDITIONS]{.underline}**

**[(Loss Settlement / Valuation / Coinsurance)]{.underline}**

**[5.1 Condition 1 --- Loss Payment]{.underline}**

We will determine the value of **Covered Property** in the event of loss or damage in accordance with the applicable provisions of this section and the **Valuation** condition set forth in Condition 3 below.

We will not pay more than the least of:

> \(a\) The Limit of Insurance applicable to the lost or damaged **Covered Property**;
>
> \(b\) The cost to repair or replace the lost or damaged property, with material of like kind and quality;
>
> \(c\) The actual amount of loss or damage, as determined by the applicable valuation method; or
>
> \(d\) Any applicable sublimit shown in the **Declarations** or stated in the Additional Coverages of this Coverage Part.

We will adjust any loss or damage to **Covered Property** based on **Actual Cash Value** as of the time of the loss or damage, unless a different valuation basis is specifically provided by an endorsement attached to this policy. Payment will be made within the time period required by applicable law following receipt of a satisfactory proof of loss. We may, at our option, either pay the value of the lost or damaged property or pay the cost of repairing or replacing it. If we pay the cost of repairing or replacing the property, we will not be liable for any value of the old or replaced property retained by the **Named Insured**.

We will give notice to the **Named Insured** of the amount of loss we have determined, and we will pay the amount of loss for which we are liable within the time required by applicable law after we receive a complete and satisfactory proof of loss.

**[5.2 Condition 2 --- Deductible]{.underline}**

In any one **occurrence** of loss or damage, we will first reduce the amount of loss or damage otherwise payable under this Coverage Part by the applicable deductible amount shown in the **Declarations**. Only one deductible amount will be applied per **occurrence**, regardless of the number of items of **Covered Property** damaged in such **occurrence**.

Deductible options available under this Coverage Part are: \$1,000, \$2,500, \$5,000, \$10,000, or \$25,000, as selected by the **Named Insured** and shown in the **Declarations**.

The deductible does not apply to the Additional Coverage for Fire Department Service Charge as set forth in Section III, Paragraph 3.4(c). The deductible applies separately to each **occurrence** of loss or damage. If loss or damage results from more than one **occurrence**, a separate deductible will apply to each **occurrence**.

**[5.3 Condition 3 --- Valuation]{.underline}**

The value of **Covered Property** will be determined at **Actual Cash Value** as of the time of loss or damage.

**Actual Cash Value** means the cost to replace the damaged property with property of like kind and quality, less a deduction for depreciation. Depreciation includes physical depreciation (wear and tear, age, and physical condition of the property) and may include functional obsolescence and economic obsolescence, as applicable.

For **tenant\'s improvements and betterments**:

> \(a\) If repaired or replaced at the expense of the **Named Insured** within a reasonable time after the loss, the value will be the actual cash value of the improvements and betterments;
>
> \(b\) If not repaired or replaced within a reasonable time after the loss, the value will be a proportion of the **Named Insured\'s** original cost of the improvements and betterments, calculated by dividing the unexpired portion of the lease at the time of loss by the period from the date the improvements and betterments were made to the expiration date of the lease. If the lease contains a renewal option, the expiration of the renewal option period will replace the expiration date of the lease in this calculation;
>
> \(c\) If others pay for the repair or replacement, we will not pay the **Named Insured** for the improvements and betterments.

For **Stock**, the value will be the **Actual Cash Value** of the **Stock** at the time of loss, determined by the selling price less discounts and expenses the **Named Insured** otherwise would have incurred.

**Replacement Cost Valuation** may be available by attachment of Endorsement MCP-RC-01, if issued. Refer to your agent or broker for details regarding the availability of replacement cost coverage and the terms and conditions thereof.

**[5.4 Condition 4 --- Recovered Property]{.underline}**

If either the **Named Insured** or we recover any property after loss settlement has been made, the party making the recovery must give prompt notice to the other party. At the **Named Insured\'s** option, the recovered property will be returned to the **Named Insured**, and the loss settlement will be adjusted based on the condition of the recovered property. If the **Named Insured** does not wish to retain the recovered property, it will become our property. We will not be required to recover or preserve any property for the **Named Insured\'s** benefit.

**[5.5 Condition 5 --- Coinsurance]{.underline}**

If a **Coinsurance** percentage is shown in the **Declarations**, the following condition applies.

We will not pay the full amount of any loss if the value of **Covered Property** at the time of loss multiplied by the **Coinsurance** percentage shown in the **Declarations** is greater than the Limit of Insurance for the property.

Instead, we will determine the most we will pay for any loss or damage using the following formula:

> **(Amount of Insurance Carried) ÷ (Amount of Insurance Required) × Loss = Amount of Recovery (before application of deductible)**

Where:

> **Amount of Insurance Carried** = the Limit of Insurance applicable to the **Covered Property** at the time of loss, as shown in the **Declarations**.
>
> **Amount of Insurance Required** = the value of the **Covered Property** at the time of loss, multiplied by the **Coinsurance** percentage shown in the **Declarations**.
>
> **Loss** = the amount of direct physical loss or damage to the **Covered Property** before application of the deductible.

**Coinsurance** options available under this Coverage Part are: 80%, 90%, or 100%, as shown in the **Declarations**.

The amount payable under this condition, after application of the coinsurance formula and the deductible, shall not exceed the applicable Limit of Insurance shown in the **Declarations**. If the **Named Insured** carries insurance equal to or greater than the amount required by the **Coinsurance** percentage, the coinsurance penalty will not apply, and the claim will be paid in accordance with the other provisions of this Coverage Part.

**[5.6 Condition 6 --- Adjustment of Loss]{.underline}**

All losses under this Coverage Part will be adjusted with the first **Named Insured** shown in the **Declarations** or, in the event of the first **Named Insured\'s** death or incapacity, with the first **Named Insured\'s** legal representative. We have the right to inspect the damaged or lost **Covered Property** and to examine and audit the **Named Insured\'s** books and records pertaining to the loss. We may use qualified independent adjusters, appraisers, or investigators in the adjustment of any loss under this Coverage Part. Any adjustment of loss with a mortgageholder will be made in accordance with Condition 8 (Mortgageholders) of Section VII.

**[SECTION VI --- COVERED CAUSES OF LOSS]{.underline}**

**[6.1 Covered Causes of Loss --- Special Form]{.underline}**

When **Special** is shown in the **Declarations**, **Covered Causes of Loss** means direct physical loss of or damage to **Covered Property** at the described **premises** unless the loss or damage is excluded or limited in this policy.

This is an open-perils basis of coverage. All causes of loss are covered unless specifically excluded or limited elsewhere in this Coverage Part. **Covered Causes of Loss** include, but are not limited to: fire, lightning, explosion, windstorm or hail, smoke, aircraft or vehicles, riot or civil commotion, vandalism, sprinkler leakage, sinkhole collapse, volcanic action, falling objects, weight of snow, ice, or sleet, and water damage (except as excluded in Section IV).

The burden of proving that a cause of loss is excluded rests with us. If we cannot demonstrate that a loss or damage was caused by an excluded cause of loss, the loss will be deemed to have been caused by a **Covered Cause of Loss**.

Under the Special Form, the limitations and exclusions set forth in Section IV of this Coverage Part apply in full. Any loss or damage that is excluded under Section IV is not a **Covered Cause of Loss**, regardless of whether it would otherwise fall within the scope of this open-perils coverage.

**[6.2 Covered Causes of Loss --- Broad Form]{.underline}**

When **Broad** is shown in the **Declarations**, **Covered Causes of Loss** are limited to the following specifically enumerated perils:

> \(a\) Fire; (b) Lightning; (c) Explosion; (d) Windstorm or hail; (e) Smoke; (f) Aircraft or vehicles; (g) Riot or civil commotion; (h) Vandalism; (i) Sprinkler leakage; (j) Sinkhole collapse; (k) Volcanic action; (l) Falling objects; (m) Weight of snow, ice, or sleet; (n) Water damage (meaning accidental discharge or leakage of water or steam from within a plumbing, heating,

When **Basic** is shown in the **Declarations**, **Covered Causes of Loss** are limited to the following specifically enumerated perils:

> \(a\) Fire; (b) Lightning; (c) Explosion; (d) Windstorm or hail; (e) Smoke; (f) Aircraft or vehicles; (g) Riot or civil commotion; (h) Vandalism; (i) Sprinkler leakage; (j) Sinkhole collapse; (k) Volcanic action.

Loss or damage caused by any peril not listed above is not covered under the Basic Form. All exclusions set forth in Section IV continue to apply.

**[SECTION VII --- GENERAL CONDITIONS]{.underline}**

**[7.1 Condition 1 --- Concealment, Misrepresentation, or Fraud]{.underline}**

This policy is void in any case of fraud by the **Named Insured** as it relates to this Coverage Part at any time. It is also void if the **Named Insured**, at any time, intentionally conceals or misrepresents a material fact concerning this Coverage Part, the **Covered Property**, the **Named Insured\'s** interest in the **Covered Property**, or a claim under this Coverage Part. The voiding of this policy due to fraud, concealment, or misrepresentation shall be effective from inception and shall apply to all claims under this Coverage Part.

**[7.2 Condition 2 --- Control of Property]{.underline}**

Acts or neglect of any person other than the **Named Insured** shall not affect the coverage provided to the **Named Insured** under this Coverage Part. This condition does not apply to any person or entity that qualifies as an **insured** under this Coverage Part.

**[7.3 Condition 3 --- Insurance Under Two or More Coverages]{.underline}**

If two or more of the Coverages provided by this Coverage Part apply to the same loss or damage, the total amount payable under all such Coverages shall not exceed the actual amount of the loss or damage sustained.

**[7.4 Condition 4 --- Other Insurance]{.underline}**

If there is other insurance covering the same loss or damage as covered under this Coverage Part, we will pay our proportionate share of the loss or damage. Our proportionate share is the proportion that the applicable Limit of Insurance under this Coverage Part bears to the total amount of insurance covering the loss or damage.

However, if the other insurance is written as excess or contingent, this Coverage Part will be primary. If this policy is written as excess or contingent, it will apply only after all other collectible insurance has been exhausted.

We will not pay more than the applicable Limit of Insurance under this Coverage Part, regardless of the existence of other insurance. If the **Named Insured** has other insurance that is written on the same basis as this Coverage Part (whether primary, contributing, excess, or contingent), we will pay our share using the following method: contribution by equal shares, up to the point where each policy has paid its equal share of the loss or has reached its Limit of Insurance, whichever comes first. If any policy reaches its Limit of Insurance before all policies have paid an equal share, the remaining policies will continue to share equally until the loss is fully paid or all Limits of Insurance are exhausted.

**[7.5 Condition 5 --- Policy Period, Coverage Territory]{.underline}**

This policy applies to loss or damage that commences during the **policy period** shown in the **Declarations**. The **policy period** begins and ends at 12:01 a.m. Standard Time at the mailing address of the first **Named Insured** shown in the **Declarations**. This policy applies only to loss or damage that occurs at the described **premises** within the State of Colorado or as otherwise specified in the **Declarations**.

**[7.6 Condition 6 --- Duties in the Event of Loss or Damage]{.underline}**

In the event of loss or damage to **Covered Property**, the **Named Insured** must:

> \(a\) Give prompt notice of the loss or damage to us or our authorized agent, including a description of the property involved and, to the extent possible, the time, place, and cause of the loss or damage;
>
> \(b\) Protect the **Covered Property** from further damage by making reasonable and necessary temporary repairs. We will reimburse the **Named Insured** for reasonable expenses incurred in protecting the property, to the extent such expenses are otherwise covered under this Coverage Part. This duty to protect does not increase the applicable Limit of Insurance;
>
> \(c\) As soon as possible, set the damaged property aside and in the best order possible for examination by our representatives;
>
> \(d\) Cooperate with us in the investigation and settlement of the claim;
>
> \(e\) Prepare an inventory of damaged personal property showing the quantity, description, **Actual Cash Value**, and amount of loss for each item. The **Named Insured** must attach all bills, receipts, and related documents to the inventory to support the claim;
>
> \(f\) As often as we may reasonably require, permit us to inspect the property, examine the **Named Insured\'s** books and records, take recorded statements, and make copies of such books and records;
>
> \(g\) Send us a signed, sworn proof of loss containing the information we request to settle the claim. **Submit to us, within thirty (30) days after our written request, a signed, sworn proof of loss** containing the following information:
>
> \(i\) The time and origin of the loss;
>
> \(ii\) The interest of the **Named Insured** and all others in the property;
>
> \(iii\) The **Actual Cash Value** of each item of damaged property and the amount of loss claimed;
>
> \(iv\) All encumbrances on the property;
>
> \(v\) All other contracts of insurance, whether valid or not, covering any of the property;
>
> \(vi\) Any changes in title, use, occupation, location, possession, or exposure of the property since the issuance of this policy; and
>
> \(vii\) All other information that we may reasonably require to investigate and settle the claim.

Failure of the **Named Insured** to comply with any of the duties described above may result in the denial of the claim or a reduction in the amount payable, as permitted by applicable law.

**[7.7 Condition 7 --- Abandonment]{.underline}**

There can be no abandonment of **Covered Property** to us. We are not obligated to accept any property abandoned by the **Named Insured**.

**[7.8 Condition 8 --- Mortgageholders]{.underline}**

If a mortgageholder is named in the **Declarations**, any loss payable under Coverage A or Coverage B will be paid to the mortgageholder and the **Named Insured**, as interests may appear. The mortgageholder has the right to receive loss payment even if the mortgageholder has started foreclosure or similar action on the **building**.

If we deny the **Named Insured\'s** claim, the denial will not apply to a valid claim of the mortgageholder, provided the mortgageholder:

> \(a\) Notifies us of any change in ownership, occupancy, or substantial change in risk of which the mortgageholder is aware;
>
> \(b\) Pays any premium due under this Coverage Part on demand if the **Named Insured** has neglected to pay the premium;
>
> \(c\) Submits a signed, sworn proof of loss within 60 days after receiving notice from us of the **Named Insured\'s** failure to do so.

If we pay the mortgageholder for any loss or damage and deny payment to the **Named Insured**:

> \(a\) We are subrogated to all rights of the mortgageholder granted under the mortgage on the property; and
>
> \(b\) At our option, we may pay to the mortgageholder the whole principal on the mortgage plus any accrued interest. In this event, we will receive a full assignment and transfer of the mortgage and all securities held as collateral to the mortgage debt.

We will give the mortgageholder at least 10 days\' written notice before cancellation of this policy for nonpayment of premium, and at least 30 days\' written notice before cancellation for any other reason.

If we elect not to renew this policy, we will give the mortgageholder written notice of nonrenewal at least 10 days before the expiration date of this policy.

**[7.9 Condition 9 --- Appraisal]{.underline}**

If we and the **Named Insured** fail to agree on the amount of loss, either may demand an appraisal of the loss. In such event, each party will select a competent and impartial appraiser within **20 days** after receiving a written demand for appraisal. The two appraisers will select an umpire. If they cannot agree on an umpire, the appraisers will attempt to resolve their differences and arrive at a mutually agreed-upon amount of loss.

The appraisers will state separately the **Actual Cash Value** and amount of loss to each item of **Covered Property**. If the appraisers submit a written report of an agreement between them, the amount agreed upon will be the amount of loss. If they fail to agree, they will submit their differences to the umpire. A decision agreed to by any two of the three (the appraisers and the umpire) will be binding on both parties.

Each party will bear the expense of its own appraiser. The expense of the umpire will be shared equally by both parties.

The appraisal process addresses only the amount of loss. It does not address questions of coverage, causation, or liability under this Coverage Part. The right to demand appraisal does not affect either party\'s right to bring a legal action against the other in accordance with Condition 15 (Legal Action Against Us).

**[7.10 Condition 10 --- Benefit to Bailee]{.underline}**

No person or organization (other than the **Named Insured**) having custody of **Covered Property** will benefit from this insurance. This policy does not confer any rights upon any bailee or any other person or organization that has care, custody, or control of **Covered Property**.

**[7.11 Condition 11 --- Vacancy]{.underline}**

If the described **building** where loss or damage occurs has been **vacant** for more than **60 consecutive days** before that loss or damage occurs:

> \(a\) We will not pay for any loss or damage caused by any of the following even if they are **Covered Causes of Loss**:
>
> \(i\) Vandalism; (ii) Sprinkler leakage, unless the **Named Insured** has protected the system against freezing by maintaining heat in the **building**; (iii) **Building** glass breakage; (iv) Water damage; (v) Theft or attempted theft.
>
> \(b\) With respect to **Covered Causes of Loss** other than those listed in paragraph (a) above, we will reduce the amount we would otherwise pay for the loss or damage by **15%**.

**Vacant** means the **building** does not contain enough **business personal property** to conduct customary **operations**. A **building** under construction or renovation is not considered **vacant**. A **building** that is used on a seasonal basis is not considered **vacant** during the off-season if it will be used for customary **operations** in the next season.

**[7.12 Condition 12 --- Cancellation and Nonrenewal]{.underline}**

**Cancellation by the Named Insured**

The first **Named Insured** shown in the **Declarations** may cancel this policy by mailing or delivering to us advance written notice of cancellation. The cancellation will be effective on the date stated in the notice or on the date the notice is received by us, whichever is later.

**Cancellation by Us**

We may cancel this policy by mailing written notice of cancellation to the first **Named Insured** at the mailing address shown in the **Declarations**.

> \(a\) If we cancel this policy within the first 60 days after the effective date of the policy and the cancellation is for a reason other than nonpayment of premium, we will mail notice of cancellation at least **10 days** before the effective date of cancellation.
>
> \(b\) If we cancel this policy after the first 60 days of the policy period, or after the first 60 days of any renewal period, we will mail notice of cancellation at least **45 days** before the effective date of cancellation, except as provided in paragraph (c) below.
>
> \(c\) If we cancel this policy for nonpayment of premium, we will mail notice of cancellation at least **10 days** before the effective date of cancellation.

**Delivery Method.** Notice of cancellation will be sent by **regular mail** to the first **Named Insured** at the mailing address shown in the **Declarations**. Proof of mailing will be sufficient proof of notice. Delivery of the notice by us shall be deemed complete upon deposit in the United States Mail, properly addressed with postage prepaid.

**Nonrenewal.** If we elect not to renew this policy, we will mail written notice of nonrenewal to the first **Named Insured** at the mailing address shown in the **Declarations** **at least 30 days before the expiration date of this policy**. Notice of nonrenewal will be sent by regular mail.

**Return of Premium**

If this policy is cancelled by us, earned premium will be computed on a pro rata basis. If this policy is cancelled by the first **Named Insured**, earned premium will be computed in accordance with the customary short-rate table and procedure, unless the **Named Insured** requests and we agree to pro rata cancellation. Premium adjustment may be made either at the time cancellation is effected or as soon as practicable after cancellation becomes effective. We will return any earned premium refund due within a reasonable time. Our check or the check of our agent, mailed or delivered, will be a sufficient tender of any refund of premium due.

**[7.13 Condition 13 --- Transfer of Interest]{.underline}**

Assignment of this policy shall not be valid except with our prior written consent. If the first **Named Insured** shown in the **Declarations** dies, this policy will cover:

> \(a\) The **Named Insured\'s** legal representative, as the **Named Insured**, but only with respect to the property of the deceased **Named Insured**; and
>
> \(b\) The person having proper temporary custody of the property until a legal representative is appointed.

This coverage applies for a period not to exceed 30 days from the date of death, or until the end of the **policy period**, whichever occurs first.

**[7.14 Condition 14 --- Transfer of Rights of Recovery Against Others to Us (Subrogation)]{.underline}**

If any person or organization to or for whom we make payment under this Coverage Part has rights to recover damages from another, those rights are transferred to us to the extent of our payment. That person or organization must do everything necessary to secure those rights and must do nothing after loss to impair them. At our request, the **Named Insured** will bring suit or transfer those rights to us and will help us enforce them.

If the **Named Insured** has waived rights of recovery against another party **in writing before a loss occurs**, we will waive our rights of recovery against that party. This waiver of our right of recovery will not apply to any party that caused or contributed to the loss through its own negligence, unless the written waiver specifically includes such party.

We will not pursue recovery from any individual who is an **insured** under this Coverage Part, except in cases involving fraud, intentional loss, or criminal acts.

**[7.15 Condition 15 --- Legal Action Against Us]{.underline}**

No one may bring a legal action against us under this Coverage Part unless:

> \(a\) There has been full compliance with all of the terms of this Coverage Part; and
>
> \(b\) The action is brought within **one (1) year** after the date on which the direct physical loss or damage occurred.

If applicable law of the State of Colorado or any other jurisdiction having authority makes the limitation in paragraph (b) above invalid, the limitation is amended to equal the minimum period of limitation permitted by such applicable law. This provision does not extend any limitation period that would otherwise apply.

**[7.16 Condition 16 --- Liberalization]{.underline}**

If we adopt any revision that would broaden the coverage under this Coverage Part without additional premium within 45 days prior to or during the **policy period**, the broadened coverage will immediately apply to this Coverage Part. This provision does not apply if the revision is implemented through an endorsement or if the **Named Insured** is required to pay additional premium for the broadened coverage.

**[7.17 Condition 17 --- Titles of Paragraphs]{.underline}**

The titles of the various paragraphs, sections, and conditions of this Coverage Part are inserted solely for convenience of reference and shall not be deemed to limit, expand, or otherwise affect the provisions to which they relate. Titles are for reference only and do not amend, restrict, or broaden coverage.

**[7.18 Condition 18 --- Conformity to Statute]{.underline}**

When the terms of this policy conflict with the applicable statutes of the State of Colorado, or the applicable statutes of any other state in which this policy is issued, this policy shall be amended to conform to such statutes. Any provision of this policy that is in conflict with the statutes of the state where this policy is issued is hereby amended to conform to the minimum requirements of such statutes.

**[7.19 Condition 19 --- Examination of Books and Records]{.underline}**

We may examine and audit the **Named Insured\'s** books and records as they relate to this policy at any time during the **policy period** and up to three (3) years after the final termination of this policy, during normal business hours at the **Named Insured\'s** premises or at such other location as the books and records may be maintained. This right extends to books and records that are relevant to the determination of premium, to the resolution of any claim, or to compliance with the terms and conditions of this policy.

**[SECTION VIII --- DEFINITIONS]{.underline}**

**[8.1 Definitions]{.underline}**

The following definitions apply to terms used throughout this Coverage Part. When a defined term appears in the text of this Coverage Part, it is shown in **bold** type.

**Actual Cash Value** --- The cost to replace damaged property with property of like kind and quality, less a deduction for depreciation. Depreciation takes into account the age, condition, and useful life remaining of the property at the time of loss. Depreciation may include physical depreciation, functional obsolescence, and economic obsolescence, as applicable.

**Bacteria** --- Any non-plant, non-animal microscopic living organism, including but not limited to Legionella pneumophila and any substances, materials, or compounds produced by, emitted from, or arising out of any **bacteria**.

**Building** --- A structure described in Coverage A of this Coverage Part, as further defined in Section III, Paragraph 3.1.

**Business Income** --- Net income (net profit or loss before income taxes) that would have been earned or incurred if no direct physical loss or damage had occurred, plus continuing normal operating expenses incurred, including payroll.

**Covered Cause of Loss** --- A cause of loss as described in Section VI of this Coverage Part. The applicable Covered Causes of Loss form (Basic, Broad, or Special) is as shown in the **Declarations**.

**Covered Property** --- Property described in Section II and Section III of this Coverage Part for which a Limit of Insurance is shown in the **Declarations**.

**Declarations** --- The Declarations page that is part of and attached to this policy, including any supplemental Declarations pages.

**Extra Expense** --- Expense incurred during the **period of restoration** that the **Named Insured** would not have incurred if there had been no direct physical loss or damage to property at the described **premises**. **Extra Expense** includes expenses to avoid or minimize the suspension of business and to continue **operations**.

**Fungi** --- Any type or form of fungus, including but not limited to mold, mildew, mushrooms, rusts, smuts, and yeasts, and any substances, materials, or compounds produced by, emitted from, or arising out of any fungus, including mycotoxins, spores, or byproducts.

**Named Insured** --- The person or entity named in Item 1 of the **Declarations** as the First Named Insured, together with any Additional Named Insureds shown in the **Declarations**.

**Occurrence** --- An accident, including continuous or repeated exposure to substantially the same general harmful conditions. All loss or damage attributable to the same accident, event, or continuous or repeated exposure to substantially the same general harmful conditions shall be considered a single **occurrence**.

**Operations** --- The **Named Insured\'s** business activities occurring at the described **premises**.

**Period of Restoration** --- The period of time that begins 72 hours after the time of direct physical loss or damage caused by or resulting from a **Covered Cause of Loss** at the described **premises** and ends on the earlier of: (a) the date when the property at the described **premises** should be repaired, rebuilt, or replaced with reasonable speed and similar quality; or (b) twelve (12) months from the date of direct physical loss or damage. The **period of restoration** does not include any increased period required due to the enforcement of any ordinance or law, except as specifically provided under the Additional Coverage for Ordinance or Law.

**Pollutants** --- Any solid, liquid, gaseous, or thermal irritant or contaminant, including but not limited to smoke, vapor, soot, fumes, acids, alkalis, chemicals, and waste. Waste includes materials to be recycled, reconditioned, or reclaimed.

**Premises** --- The location or locations described in the **Declarations** where **Covered Property** is situated.

**Stock** --- Merchandise held in storage or for sale, raw materials, and in-process or finished goods, including supplies used in their packing or shipping.

**TRIPRA** --- The Terrorism Risk Insurance Program Reauthorization Act of 2019 (Public Law 116-94), as amended, or any successor legislation thereto.

**Vacant** --- A **building** is **vacant** when it does not contain enough **business personal property** to conduct customary **operations**.

**We, Us, Our** --- Meridian Casualty Insurance Company, the company issuing this policy, as named in the header of this Coverage Part.

**You, Your** --- The **Named Insured** shown in the **Declarations**, including the First Named Insured and any Additional Named Insureds.

**[DOCUMENT END MATTER]{.underline}**

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, **Meridian Casualty Insurance Company** has caused this policy to be executed and attested by its duly authorized officers at its Home Office in Chicago, Illinois, effective as of the date shown in the **Declarations**.

This policy shall not be valid unless countersigned by the authorized representative of the Company.

MERIDIAN CASUALTY INSURANCE COMPANY

By: **\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Pt, RGBColor, Inches, Cm
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH
from docx.enum.table import WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT
from docx.enum.section import WD_ORIENT
from docx.oxml.ns import qn
from docx.oxml import OxmlElement

SEV_COLORS = {"Critical": "C00000", "High": "E26B0A", "Medium": "BF8F00", "Low": "548235"}

def new_doc():
    d = Document()
    st = d.styles["Normal"]
    st.font.name = "Calibri"
    st.font.size = Pt(10.5)
    st.element.rPr.rFonts.set(qn("w:eastAsia"), "Calibri")
    pf = st.paragraph_format
    pf.space_after = Pt(5)
    pf.line_spacing = 1.08
    for name, size, color in [("Heading 1", 14, "1F3864"), ("Heading 2", 12, "1F3864"), ("Heading 3", 11, "2E74B5")]:
        h = d.styles[name]
        h.font.name = "Calibri"
        h.font.size = Pt(size)
        h.font.bold = True
        h.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(color)
        h.element.rPr.rFonts.set(qn("w:eastAsia"), "Calibri")
        h.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(10)
        h.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(4)
        h.paragraph_format.keep_with_next = True
    sec = d.sections[0]
    sec.left_margin = sec.right_margin = Inches(0.9)
    sec.top_margin = sec.bottom_margin = Inches(0.85)
    return d

def shade(cell, hexcolor):
    tcPr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    shd = OxmlElement("w:shd")
    shd.set(qn("w:val"), "clear")
    shd.set(qn("w:color"), "auto")
    shd.set(qn("w:fill"), hexcolor)
    tcPr.append(shd)

def add_runs(p, text, size=None, color=None, italic=False):
    # supports **bold** segments
    parts = text.split("**")
    for i, seg in enumerate(parts):
        if not seg:
            continue
        r = p.add_run(seg)
        r.bold = (i % 2 == 1)
        r.italic = italic
        if size:
            r.font.size = Pt(size)
        if color:
            r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(color)
    return p

def para(d, text, bold=False, italic=False, size=None, align=None, color=None, after=None, indent=None):
    p = d.add_paragraph()
    if bold:
        text = "**" + text + "**"
    add_runs(p, text, size=size, color=color, italic=italic)
    if align == "center":
        p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    if after is not None:
        p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(after)
    if indent:
        p.paragraph_format.left_indent = Inches(indent)
    return p

def bullet(d, text, level=0, numbered=False):
    style = "List Number" if numbered else ("List Bullet" if level == 0 else "List Bullet 2")
    p = d.add_paragraph(style=style)
    add_runs(p, text)
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return p

def quote(d, text):
    p = d.add_paragraph()
    add_runs(p, text, italic=False)
    p.paragraph_format.left_indent = Inches(0.4)
    p.paragraph_format.right_indent = Inches(0.3)
    pPr = p._p.get_or_add_pPr()
    bdr = OxmlElement("w:pBdr")
    left = OxmlElement("w:left")
    left.set(qn("w:val"), "single"); left.set(qn("w:sz"), "12"); left.set(qn("w:space"), "8"); left.set(qn("w:color"), "8EAADB")
    bdr.append(left); pPr.append(bdr)
    return p

def set_col_widths(table, widths):
    for row in table.rows:
        for i, w in enumerate(widths):
            if i < len(row.cells):
                row.cells[i].width = Inches(w)

def table(d, header, rows, widths, font=9, header_fill="1F3864", sev_col=None):
    t = d.add_table(rows=1, cols=len(header))
    t.style = "Table Grid"
    t.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
    for i, h in enumerate(header):
        c = t.rows[0].cells[i]
        c.text = ""
        p = c.paragraphs[0]
        r = p.add_run(h); r.bold = True; r.font.size = Pt(font); r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(255, 255, 255)
        shade(c, header_fill)
    # repeat header
    trPr = t.rows[0]._tr.get_or_add_trPr()
    th = OxmlElement("w:tblHeader"); th.set(qn("w:val"), "true"); trPr.append(th)
    for row in rows:
        cells = t.add_row().cells
        for i, val in enumerate(row):
            c = cells[i]
            c.text = ""
            lines = str(val).split("\n")
            for j, line in enumerate(lines):
                p = c.paragraphs[0] if j == 0 else c.add_paragraph()
                p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(1)
                add_runs(p, line, size=font)
            if sev_col is not None and i == sev_col and val in SEV_COLORS:
                shade(c, SEV_COLORS[val])
                for p in c.paragraphs:
                    for r in p.runs:
                        r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(255, 255, 255); r.bold = True
    set_col_widths(t, widths)
    d.add_paragraph().paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return t

def kv_table(d, pairs, sev=None, widths=(1.55, 5.15), font=9.5):
    t = d.add_table(rows=0, cols=2)
    t.style = "Table Grid"
    for k, v in pairs:
        cells = t.add_row().cells
        cells[0].text = ""
        r = cells[0].paragraphs[0].add_run(k); r.bold = True; r.font.size = Pt(font)
        shade(cells[0], "D9E2F3")
        cells[1].text = ""
        lines = v.split("\n")
        for j, line in enumerate(lines):
            p = cells[1].paragraphs[0] if j == 0 else cells[1].add_paragraph()
            p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
            if line.startswith("- "):
                p.paragraph_format.left_indent = Inches(0.15)
                line = "• " + line[2:]
            add_runs(p, line, size=font)
        if k == "Severity" and sev in SEV_COLORS:
            shade(cells[1], SEV_COLORS[sev])
            for p in cells[1].paragraphs:
                for r in p.runs:
                    r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(255, 255, 255); r.bold = True
    set_col_widths(t, widths)
    d.add_paragraph().paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return t

def footer(d, text):
    for s in d.sections:
        p = s.footer.paragraphs[0]
        p.text = ""
        r = p.add_run(text); r.font.size = Pt(8); r.italic = True
        p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
        # page number
        r2 = p.add_run("   |   Page "); r2.font.size = Pt(8)
        fld1 = OxmlElement("w:fldSimple"); fld1.set(qn("w:instr"), "PAGE")
        rr = OxmlElement("w:r"); tt = OxmlElement("w:t"); tt.text = "1"; rr.append(tt); fld1.append(rr)
        p._p.append(fld1)
EOF

/home/user/Lawless_Research_Lab/harvey_lab/sbx.sh /home/user/Lawless_Research_Lab/harvey_lab/vendor/harvey-labs/results/insurance/compare-commercial-property-policy-form-against-state-regulatory-requirements/claude-code-session/20261016-023511 'mkdir -p /workspace/build && cat > /workspace/build/helpers.py << "EOF"
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Pt, RGBColor, Inches, Cm
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH
from docx.enum.table import WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT
from docx.enum.section import WD_ORIENT
from docx.oxml.ns import qn
from docx.oxml import OxmlElement

SEV_COLORS = {"Critical": "C00000", "High": "E26B0A", "Medium": "BF8F00", "Low": "548235"}

def new_doc():
    d = Document()
    st = d.styles["Normal"]
    st.font.name = "Calibri"
    st.font.size = Pt(10.5)
    st.element.rPr.rFonts.set(qn("w:eastAsia"), "Calibri")
    pf = st.paragraph_format
    pf.space_after = Pt(5)
    pf.line_spacing = 1.08
    for name, size, color in [("Heading 1", 14, "1F3864"), ("Heading 2", 12, "1F3864"), ("Heading 3", 11, "2E74B5")]:
        h = d.styles[name]
        h.font.name = "Calibri"
        h.font.size = Pt(size)
        h.font.bold = True
        h.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(color)
        h.element.rPr.rFonts.set(qn("w:eastAsia"), "Calibri")
        h.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(10)
        h.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(4)
        h.paragraph_format.keep_with_next = True
    sec = d.sections[0]
    sec.left_margin = sec.right_margin = Inches(0.9)
    sec.top_margin = sec.bottom_margin = Inches(0.85)
    return d

def shade(cell, hexcolor):
    tcPr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    shd = OxmlElement("w:shd")
    shd.set(qn("w:val"), "clear")
    shd.set(qn("w:color"), "auto")
    shd.set(qn("w:fill"), hexcolor)
    tcPr.append(shd)

def add_runs(p, text, size=None, color=None, italic=False):
    # supports **bold** segments
    parts = text.split("**")
    for i, seg in enumerate(parts):
        if not seg:
            continue
        r = p.add_run(seg)
        r.bold = (i % 2 == 1)
        r.italic = italic
        if size:
            r.font.size = Pt(size)
        if color:
            r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(color)
    return p

def para(d, text, bold=False, italic=False, size=None, align=None, color=None, after=None, indent=None):
    p = d.add_paragraph()
    if bold:
        text = "**" + text + "**"
    add_runs(p, text, size=size, color=color, italic=italic)
    if align == "center":
        p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    if after is not None:
        p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(after)
    if indent:
        p.paragraph_format.left_indent = Inches(indent)
    return p

def bullet(d, text, level=0, numbered=False):
    style = "List Number" if numbered else ("List Bullet" if level == 0 else "List Bullet 2")
    p = d.add_paragraph(style=style)
    add_runs(p, text)
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return p

def quote(d, text):
    p = d.add_paragraph()
    add_runs(p, text, italic=False)
    p.paragraph_format.left_indent = Inches(0.4)
    p.paragraph_format.right_indent = Inches(0.3)
    pPr = p._p.get_or_add_pPr()
    bdr = OxmlElement("w:pBdr")
    left = OxmlElement("w:left")
    left.set(qn("w:val"), "single"); left.set(qn("w:sz"), "12"); left.set(qn("w:space"), "8"); left.set(qn("w:color"), "8EAADB")
    bdr.append(left); pPr.append(bdr)
    return p

def set_col_widths(table, widths):
    for row in table.rows:
        for i, w in enumerate(widths):
            if i < len(row.cells):
                row.cells[i].width = Inches(w)

def table(d, header, rows, widths, font=9, header_fill="1F3864", sev_col=None):
    t = d.add_table(rows=1, cols=len(header))
    t.style = "Table Grid"
    t.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
    for i, h in enumerate(header):
        c = t.rows[0].cells[i]
        c.text = ""
        p = c.paragraphs[0]
        r = p.add_run(h); r.bold = True; r.font.size = Pt(font); r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(255, 255, 255)
        shade(c, header_fill)
    # repeat header
    trPr = t.rows[0]._tr.get_or_add_trPr()
    th = OxmlElement("w:tblHeader"); th.set(qn("w:val"), "true"); trPr.append(th)
    for row in rows:
        cells = t.add_row().cells
        for i, val in enumerate(row):
            c = cells[i]
            c.text = ""
            lines = str(val).split("\n")
            for j, line in enumerate(lines):
                p = c.paragraphs[0] if j == 0 else c.add_paragraph()
                p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(1)
                add_runs(p, line, size=font)
            if sev_col is not None and i == sev_col and val in SEV_COLORS:
                shade(c, SEV_COLORS[val])
                for p in c.paragraphs:
                    for r in p.runs:
                        r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(255, 255, 255); r.bold = True
    set_col_widths(t, widths)
    d.add_paragraph().paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return t

def kv_table(d, pairs, sev=None, widths=(1.55, 5.15), font=9.5):
    t = d.add_table(rows=0, cols=2)
    t.style = "Table Grid"
    for k, v in pairs:
        cells = t.add_row().cells
        cells[0].text = ""
        r = cells[0].paragraphs[0].add_run(k); r.bold = True; r.font.size = Pt(font)
        shade(cells[0], "D9E2F3")
        cells[1].text = ""
        lines = v.split("\n")
        for j, line in enumerate(lines):
            p = cells[1].paragraphs[0] if j == 0 else cells[1].add_paragraph()
            p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
            if line.startswith("- "):
                p.paragraph_format.left_indent = Inches(0.15)
                line = "\u2022 " + line[2:]
            add_runs(p, line, size=font)
        if k == "Severity" and sev in SEV_COLORS:
            shade(cells[1], SEV_COLORS[sev])
            for p in cells[1].paragraphs:
                for r in p.runs:
                    r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(255, 255, 255); r.bold = True
    set_col_widths(t, widths)
    d.add_paragraph().paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return t

def footer(d, text):
    for s in d.sections:
        p = s.footer.paragraphs[0]
        p.text = ""
        r = p.add_run(text); r.font.size = Pt(8); r.italic = True
        p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
        # page number
        r2 = p.add_run("   |   Page "); r2.font.size = Pt(8)
        fld1 = OxmlElement("w:fldSimple"); fld1.set(qn("w:instr"), "PAGE")
        rr = OxmlElement("w:r"); tt = OxmlElement("w:t"); tt.text = "1"; rr.append(tt); fld1.append(rr)
        p._p.append(fld1)
EOF
echo ok'

        "- Search the revised form and every companion form, notice and system-generated letter template for “30 days” and “thirty” and conform them.\n"
        "- In the SERFF filing description and transmittal letter, state affirmatively that the form uses the 45-day nonrenewal period accepted by the Division in MERI-2021-003.\n"
        "- Add this item to Meridian’s Colorado pre-filing QC list for all future property filings.",
  checklist="Entries 1.2, 5.2, 10.1 — Non-Compliant (agree).")

g(id="2", sev="Critical", typ="Substantive", repeat="YES — repeats MERI-2023-007",
  title="No wildfire coverage disclosure anywhere in the form",
  short="No wildfire disclosure (repeat objection)",
  section="Entire form. No wildfire-specific section, notice, or Declarations entry exists; the word “wildfire” does not appear anywhere in the 38-page form.   cite="C.R.S. § 10-4-110.5; Division Objection Letter, SERFF Filing MERI-2023-007 (March 22, 2023); Colorado DOI Form Filing Guidance, § 7.3 (Wildfire Disclosures) (model language cited by the Division).",
  issue="Ms. Brennan’s concern is correct. The form as drafted does **not** satisfy § 10-4-110.5. It presents exactly the situation the Division rejected in 2023, when it held that “the inclusion of fire as a covered peril does not, standing alone, satisfy the disclosure requirements of the statute” and that a “separate, specific disclosure … distinct from the general insuring agreement or covered causes of loss provisions” is required. Measured element by element (see Section III.B), every element is absent: (1) whether wildfire is covered; (2) wildfire-specific sublimits; (3) wildfire-specific exclusions or limitations; (4) wildfire-specific deductibles; (5) a clear and conspicuous plain-language statement of coverage status; and the two further elements listed in checklist Entry 3.1, namely (c) a wildfire-prone-area risk notice and (d) mitigation resource information.\n"
        "**Simply re-attaching MCP-WF-01 will not be enough.** According to Meridian’s internal disposition notes, the 2023 endorsement covered four items: covered status, no separate sublimit, no separate deductible, and a bold plain-language notice. The proprietary form adds several limitations that bear directly on wildfire losses and that a policyholder would need to understand (Appendix B), including the 25%/$250,000 debris-removal cap, the actual-cash-value default, the 72-hour waiting period and 12-month cap on business income, the vacancy restrictions, the off-premises utility-failure exclusion (relevant to utility-initiated power shutoffs), the mudslide/mudflow exclusions (post-fire debris flows), and the absence of civil authority coverage for evacuation orders. The Division’s element (3) requires disclosure of “any conditions or circumstances under which wildfire coverage may not apply.”",
  action="Prepare a new Colorado wildfire disclosure and use **both** placement methods the Division accepted in 2023 (draft text in Appendix A-2):\n"
        "- **In the form:** insert a boxed, clearly labeled section titled “IMPORTANT NOTICE REGARDING WILDFIRE COVERAGE” on page 1, immediately after the opening policy notice and before Section I (Declarations). Set it apart from the surrounding text in bold type of at least 10 points.\n"
        "- **As a mandatory notice:** file a companion notice (suggested number MCP-WF-02 CO) to be delivered at inception and at each renewal. List it in ¶ 1.6 as a mandatory form for every Colorado policy rather than as an optional endorsement.\n"
        "- **In the Declarations:** add to ¶ 1.4 the lines “Wildfire-specific sublimit: None” and “Wildfire-specific deductible: None (policy deductible applies)”, or show the amounts where underwriting applies them.\n"
        "- Start from the DOI Guidance § 7.3 model language and cover every element in both the Division letter and checklist Entry 3.1.\n"
        "- File the notice in the same SERFF submission as a required attachment, and cite the MERI-2023-007 remediation in the transmittal.",
  checklist="Entries 3.1, 10.2 — Non-Compliant (agree). The element list in the checklist differs from the Division’s letter; see Gap 15.")

g(id="3", sev="Critical", typ="Procedural", repeat="No",
  title="Readability testing not performed; certificate is a SERFF filing prerequisite",
  short="Readability certificate not yet obtained (filing prerequisite)",
  section="Entire form (all 38 pages) and every new companion notice; SERFF filing package.",
  cite="3 CCR 702-4, Regulation 4-2-13 (Flesch Reading Ease of 40 or more, or Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level of 12 or lower; certificate or test score must accompany the filing).",
  issue="No readability score exists. Per the Division requirement described in the checklist and the transmittal, the filing cannot be accepted without a certificate, and Trenton Filing Services has said it cannot assemble the MERI-133318601 package without one. There is also a timing conflict. The checklist sets readability testing for completion “no later than February 15, 2025,” one day **after** the February 14 target for the revised form. The certified score has to be run on the **final** text, including the new wildfire, replacement cost, coinsurance and terrorism language. A score run on the current draft therefore cannot support the filing. The current text has very long sentences that are likely to depress the score (e.g., the Business Income measurement paragraph in ¶ 3.3, which is a single sentence of about 90 words; Exclusion 9; Exclusion 14; Condition 4 (Other Insurance)).",
  action="- **By February 10:** run a diagnostic Flesch and Flesch-Kincaid test on the current draft, section by section, so that plain-language fixes can be built into the February 14 revision.\n"
        "- **February 18–21:** run the certified test on the frozen final form and all companion notices; document the method used (text tested, any exclusions such as captions and Declarations blanks); obtain an officer-signed certificate.\n"
        "- Deliver the certificate to Trenton by about February 24, leaving time to re-test if the score falls short.\n"
        "- Write the new disclosures at a low grade level from the start (short sentences, second person, question-and-answer headings).",
  checklist="Entries 7.1, 11.1 — Not Yet Reviewed. Treat as an open Critical action item and move the target date earlier.")
EOF

g(id="4", sev="High", typ="Substantive", repeat="No",
  title="Proof of loss deadline is 30 days; Colorado requires at least 60 days",
  short="Proof of loss 30 days vs. 60-day minimum",
  section="Section VII, Condition 6(g) (Duties in the Event of Loss or Damage) (¶ 7.6(g)); related: ¶ 2.1 (“no duty to pay … until we receive a satisfactory proof of loss”) and the closing sentence of ¶ 7.6 (failure to comply “may result in the denial of the claim”).",
  cite="C.R.S. § 10-4-105.2; C.R.S. § 10-4-105 (standard fire policy, 60-day proof of loss).",
  issue="¶ 7.6(g) requires the insured to “**Submit to us, within thirty (30) days after our written request, a signed, sworn proof of loss**.” That is half the statutory minimum. g(id="16", sev="Medium", typ="Substantive", repeat="No",
  title="One-year suit limitation running from the date of loss",
  short="One-year suit limitation from date of loss",
  section="Section VII, Condition 15 (Legal Action Against Us) (¶ 7.15); interacts with ¶ 7.9 (appraisal does not affect the limitation).",

  issue="The clause requires suit within one year after the loss occurred, conditioned on “full compliance with all of the terms.” The general Colorado limitation for contract actions is three years. A one-year period that runs from the loss date, and not from denial, keeps running during adjustment and appraisal. In large wildfire losses, where debris removal, permitting and rebuilding take well over a year, the insured can lose the right to sue before the claim is resolved. The Division has emphasized policyholder protection after the Marshall Fire. The savings sentence (“amended to equal the minimum period of limitation permitted by such applicable law”) leaves the insured unable to tell from the form what the period actually is, which is itself a transparency concern. The clause also should not purport to limit statutory claims under §§ 10-3-1115/1116. Whether a one-year contractual period is enforceable in a Colorado commercial property policy is a question of Colorado contract law that we will confirm in a short follow-up research memo. Our recommendation does not depend on the answer: the Division may object regardless, and the clause invites litigation.",
  action="Extend the period to at least two years (preferably three, matching § 13-80-101) from the date of loss. Add tolling from the date notice of loss is given until the date Meridian issues a written coverage decision, and tolling during appraisal. State that the condition does not apply to claims under C.R.S. §§ 10-3-1115 and 10-3-1116. Keep the conformity sentence as a backstop only.",
  checklist="Entry 8.1 — Not Yet Reviewed; we revise to **Potential Issue (recommend revision)**.")

g(id="17", sev="Medium", typ="Substantive", repeat="No",

  section="¶ 4.14 (Terrorism, which excludes ensuing fire); ¶ 4.12 (Intentional Loss, which bars innocent co-insureds); ¶ 4.9 (absolute Mold exclusion); ¶ 7.1 (Concealment/Fraud voids from inception); ¶ 7.9 (Appraisal); ¶ 7.6(g) (Proof of loss); ¶ 5.1 (Loss Payment timing).",
  cite="C.R.S. § 10-4-105 (standard fire policy; deviations permitted only if at least as favorable to the insured); checklist Entry 2.1.",
  issue="We completed the line-by-line comparison that checklist Entry 2.1 left open. Proof of loss (Gap 4), appraisal (Gap 9) and loss-payment timing (Gap 18) are addressed separately. The remaining deviations that may be less favorable than the standard fire policy are:\n"
        "- **Ensuing fire from terrorism (¶ 4.14):** the exclusion applies “including but not limited to fire.” The standard fire policy does not exclude terrorism. In standard-fire-policy states, ISO terrorism exclusions carve back fire following a certified act. Excluding that fire is likely less favorable than the statutory standard. By contrast, the form does carve back ensuing fire in Exclusions 2, 4, 7 and 15.\n"
        "- **Innocent co-insureds (¶ 4.12):** “no insured is entitled to coverage … even insureds who did not commit or conspire to commit the act.” The standard fire policy ties forfeiture to “the insured’s” own conduct. Barring innocent co-insureds (for example, a partner or co-owner) is less favorable. The term “insured” is also undefined (Gap 24).\n"

  section="¶ 2.1 (“no duty to pay … until we receive a satisfactory proof of loss”); ¶ 5.1 (payment “within the time period required by applicable law” after a “complete and satisfactory proof of loss”).",
  cite="C.R.S. § 10-4-105 (standard fire policy: loss payable within 60 days after proof of loss and ascertainment of the loss); C.R.S. § 10-3-1104(1)(h) (unfair claim settlement practices); C.R.S. §§ 10-3-1115, 10-3-1116.",
  issue="The form never states when Meridian will pay. Its references to “applicable law” and a “satisfactory” proof of loss leave it to Meridian’s discretion when the payment obligation starts.   action="State a payment commitment, for example: “We will pay for covered loss or damage within 60 days after we receive your sworn proof of loss, if you have complied with all the terms of this Coverage Part and we have reached agreement with you on the amount of loss or an appraisal award has been made.” Replace “satisfactory” with “complete,” and commit to telling the insured in writing what additional information is needed.",

  cite="General filing requirement that limits and sublimits be clearly stated (checklist Entry 9.2); C.R.S. § 10-4-110 (description of coverage); 3 CCR 702-4, Regs. 4-2-1 to 4-2-10; C.R.S. § 10-4-110.5 (wildfire-relevant limits must be disclosed).",

I've written the gap analysis as /workspace/output/compliance-gap-analysis.docx. Form MCP-2025-01 is not ready to file: it repeats both prior Division objections, and the readability certificate the filing requires has not been obtained. The document lists 29 gaps from most to least critical (3 Critical, 12 High, 8 Medium, 6 Low), with a severity count at the top. It passes the docx validator and I parsed it back to check that every section is present.

**The two repeat objections**
- **Nonrenewal (MERI-2021-003):** Section VII, Condition 12 again gives only 30 days' notice of nonrenewal; Colorado requires 45.
- **Wildfire disclosure (MERI-2023-007):** the form has no wildfire disclosure of any kind, and the word "wildfire" appears nowhere in it. Re-attaching the 2023 wildfire endorsement (MCP-WF-01) would not be enough. The new form has limits that bite in a wildfire and that the disclosure has to name: the debris-removal cap, actual cash value as the default, no civil authority coverage for evacuations, and the mudflow and off-premises power-failure exclusions.

**Problems in the same condition that Meridian's checklist missed**
- Meridian can cancel on 10 days' notice for any reason during the first 60 days of every policy and every renewal.
- Notices are not required to state reasons. The checklist quotes "will state the reason" language, but it is not in the final form.
- Notices go by "regular mail" rather than first-class, with no consented e-delivery option.
- The mortgageholder gets only 10 days' notice of nonrenewal.

**Other High items**
- Proof of loss is due in 30 days; Colorado requires at least 60.
- Replacement cost is never actually offered; the form only says an endorsement "may be available."
- The appraisal clause has no fallback for a judge to pick the umpire.
- The coinsurance clause has no plain-language explanation or dollar example.
- The terrorism disclosure lacks the premium, the federal share and the insurer deductible.
- A "premiums fully earned at inception" sentence contradicts the refund terms.
- The required companion notices and endorsements have not been drafted or filed.

**Problems with Meridian's checklist**
- Four entries marked "Compliant" do not hold up against the final form (1.1, 1.3, 6.1 and 9.2). They appear to have been checked against the December 20 draft.
- Its record of the prior objections conflicts with the actual letters on dates, signatory, approval dates and the number of required wildfire elements. Its summary counts are also wrong. This should be corrected before any filing history goes to the Division.
- The readability testing target (February 15) falls after the February 14 revision date, and the certified test has to be run on the final text.

**What the document contains:** a detailed write-up of each gap covering the five points Meridian asked for, an entry-by-entry re-check of the checklist, the list of pre-filing procedural items, a revised timeline, and draft replacement language in the appendices.

**Two caveats**
- The requirements are taken as described in the Division's letters and Meridian's checklist. Some citations should be checked against the current official Colorado text before filing. For example, the commercial cancellation rules also appear at C.R.S. § 10-4-109.7, and § 10-4-110.8 is generally a homeowner's statute.
- The March 1, 2025 filing date falls on a Saturday, so the filing agent's availability needs confirming (or the target moved to February 28).
